# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Engine fixes and hash initialization**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 incorporates upstream Skia m158 bug fixes. The shared hash-code helper in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp also changes its per-process seed source while preserving within-process stability.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Refresh Skia m158 bug fixes** — Updates the bundled renderer with upstream fixes from the chrome/m158 branch while retaining milestone 158. ([#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Use operating-system randomness for hash initialization** — The shared HashCode helper in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now uses RandomNumberGenerator for its per-process seed. Hashes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process. First use now loads System.Security.Cryptography and has additional startup cost. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
